properties.summary: Incident Type: AIRCRAFT - NRC Report ID: 1308383 - Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A) - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1308383
Incident Time: 2021-06-21 05:00:00
Nearest City: Flushing, NY
Location: DITMARS BLVD & 94TH STREET
Location2: LGA AIRPORT
Incident Type: AIRCRAFT
Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A)
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.770433, -73.875948 (Approximated from intersection)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT AT 0500 HOURS ON JUNE 21, 2021 A PASSENGER ARRIVED AT THE SPRITE TICKET COUNTER FOR THEIR FLIGHT FROM LGA TO FLL. BECAUSE ONE OF THE PASSENGER"S BAGS WERE OVERWEIGHT THE AIRLINE ALLOWED THE PASSENGER TO TRANSFER SOME OF THE CONTENTS TO ANOTHER BAG. THE PASSENGER’S BAGS WERE TAKEN AS CHECKED LUGGAGE AND SENT TO THE TRANSPORTATION SECURITY ADMINISTRATION (TSA) FOR INSPECTION. ONE OF THE PASSENGERS BAGS WAS ALLOWED TO PROCEED TO SPIRIT AIRLINES FLIGHT NKS171, AND THE OTHER WAS HELD BY TSA FOR ADDITIONAL SCREENING. WHEN TSA CONDUCTED ITS SEARCH HUNDREDS OF CELL PHONES WERE DISCOVERED AND THAT BAG NEVER MADE IT ONTO THE FLIGHT. BECAUSE OF THE AMOUNT AND BECAUSE THE PHONES CONTAINED LITHIUM BATTERIES FLIGHT NKS171 WAS DIVERTED TO MCO FROM ITS ORIGINAL DESTINATION OF FLL. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER THE FIRST BAG THAT WAS LEFT AT LGA WILL BE PICKED UP BY AN ACQUAINTANCE OF THE PASSENGER. THE SECOND BAG WAS RETRIEVED BY THE PASSENGER AFTER THE FLIGHT LANDED. THE PASSENGER THEN MADE OTHER TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS THAT WOULD ALLOW THEM TO TRANSPORT THE PHONES IN QUESTION.
